permitted_use: All Uses, except as otherwise specified in this title

standards.SUBPART B: Floor area ratio: not to exceed 50%; see Chapter 20.10
standards.SUBPART C: Where a P-I tract abuts railroad property containing a spur track on the rear or side property line, structures may extend to the property line for the purpose of receiving railroad service.
standards.SUBPART D: No building shall exceed 40', not including machinery rooms, spires, antennas, etc.
